faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all Range Rover Velar models?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across the full Velar range, including the limited-run SVAutobiography Dynamic Edition.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Velar already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Range Rover Velar engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: 4-cylinder rebuilds start from £2,200, 6-cylinder from £3,200, and the SVAutobiography Dynamic Edition's supercharged V8 from £5,500. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: My Velar has an "SVAutobiography" badge — is that the same as the 5.0 V8?
faqRight.a: Yes, if it's specifically the "SVAutobiography Dynamic Edition," it's fitted with the same 5.0L supercharged V8 used in the Range Rover Sport SVR — a very limited, one-year-only (2019) run. Submit your reg and we'll confirm the exact spec before quoting.
